manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the beige mug with the left arm, rotate, place it, then hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.

Task description: The object is the beige handled cup on the left side of the table, and the target is the gray cup rack with a straight bar and an angled bar on the right. Use the left arm to pick up the cup, turn and place it, and hang it.

Success criteria: Hang the beige cup by its handle on the rack, horizontally near its middle hanging region and raised to rod height clearly above the table. The right gripper must remain open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping an upper cup-wall section away from the handle, with one finger inside and one outside. Set the opening for wall thickness and interior clearance, leaving room for the handle to enter the rack.
- Before closing, use the side view to confirm that the fingers are on the inside and outside of the cup wall, avoiding a grip that presses only on the rim without holding the wall effectively.
- When turning the cup, leave room for the bottom and protruding handle to swing, avoiding contact with the table or cup-rack post.
- To hang the cup, face the handle opening toward the free end of the angled rod and make small adjustments along the rod, avoiding the tip pressing on the handle edge or cup body.
- If a regrasp is needed, first let the cup bottom rest securely on the table. At the hanging location, let the inside of the handle rest on the bar and bear the cup’s weight before releasing, to avoid slipping when released unsupported.
